recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It completes the ETSI commitment-type application without broadening the issue scope; no follow-up is needed unless the work group later decides to add additional ETSI commitment types beyond the six listed in the Jira description/comment.
issue_request: FHIR-20807 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by the Security work group and requested adding ETSI digital signature commitment types as a new ETSI CodeSystem, then including that vocabulary with the existing ASTM signature types in the Signature.type value set.
initial_application: Commit 591b6b1e2a pre-applied the request by adding source/datatypes/codesystem-etsi-signature-type.xml and including http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.2.2 in source/datatypes/valueset-signature-type.xml. Later commits fixed XML/OID metadata, and commit 8e5295fb added an active Provenance example using the ETSI approval code. The remaining application defect was that the case-sensitive Jira/ETSI ProofOfApproval URI fragment appeared as ProofOfapproval in both the CodeSystem and example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Signature as a datatype and the ETSI CodeSystem under [codesystems], while Provenance is an active resource and list-Provenance-examples.xml includes the diagnostic report signature example. The value set already includes both ETSI and ASTM systems and Signature.type remains bound to that value set. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later discussion or meeting record changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/codesystem-etsi-signature-type.xml from ProofOfapproval to ProofOfApproval and updated source/provenance/provenance-example-diagnosticreport-sig.xml to use the corrected code.
source_changes: source/datatypes/codesystem-etsi-signature-type.xml: corrected the ETSI proof-of-approval concept code to ProofOfApproval.
source/provenance/provenance-example-diagnosticreport-sig.xml: updated the active Provenance signature example to use ProofOfApproval.

evidence_items.summary: The active ETSI CodeSystem uses system http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.2.2, is case-sensitive, and now defines ProofOfApproval.
evidence_items.learned: Correcting the case is a semantic fix because ProofOfapproval and ProofOfApproval are distinct in a case-sensitive CodeSystem.

evidence_items.learned: The requested value set inclusion and datatype binding are already applied, so only the incorrect ETSI code spelling required reconciliation.
